guiding.heroSubtitle: Fly above the flatlands of Macedonia. Seven days of XC flying from Krushevo — the highest town in the Balkans (1,350 m).
guiding.whyLead: Krushevo sits at 1,350 m — the highest town in the Balkans. Here flatlands meet mountains, which makes it a great place to learn thermals and long XC flights.
guiding.whyBody: The two main take-offs face east and west, so we can fly on most days, no matter the wind. Good asphalt roads go all the way up to the grass launches, so access is easy for every pilot. Krushevo has hosted the Paragliding World Cup and World and European Championships — the conditions really are that good.
guiding.bullet1: Mixed terrain — flatlands and mountains in the same flight
guiding.bullet2: Two take-offs (east and west) with easy road access
guiding.bullet3: A well-known XC spot — host of the Paragliding World Cup
guiding.whereLead: Krushevo is our base. If the weather is better somewhere else, we drive to other top sites so you always fly the best option of the day.
guiding.where1: Krushevo — Meckin Kamen, the main east/west take-off
guiding.where2: Treskavec — mountain launch for longer flights
guiding.where3: Sliva — backup site for changing weather
guiding.where4: Ohrid — lake flying from Galicica on rest days
guiding.need1: Paragliding equipment — checked, insured, within permitted weight
guiding.need2: International health insurance with medical repatriation (e.g. ADAC Premium)
guiding.priceNote: Lunch and dinner outside the package are not included. Confirm current season pricing when you book.
guiding.afterTitle: More than flying — a great place to relax
guiding.afterLead: After a long day in the air, Krushevo is a nice place to rest. The town has many small restaurants, cafés and bars where pilots meet, share stories and enjoy Macedonian food and hospitality.
guiding.afterFood: Local food and family restaurants close to the landing field
guiding.afterCafe: Cafés and bars with a panoramic view — a good spot to talk about the flight
guiding.afterCulture: The highest town in the Balkans — with a long history and lots of character
guiding.bookLead: Pick check-in and check-out on the calendar below, then send a request. You will get an email once the owner confirms.
guiding.enquireLead: Not sure about dates? Send us a message and we will reply with free dates, prices and all the info you need.

tandem.heroSubtitle: Tandem paragliding — no experience required. Fly with certified pilots above lakes, mountains, and valleys.
tandem.p1: Have you ever wanted to experience the absolute freedom of flight? Want an adrenaline rush, to see Macedonia from a different perspective, to spoil your partner, or to do something you have never done before? Try a tandem paragliding flight with the PG Macedonia team.
tandem.p2: No prior paragliding experience is required. Passengers are seated and strapped into a harness attached to the pilot — the only input needed from you is a short run on take-off and landing. The average tandem flight lasts about 15 minutes, and all flights are weather dependent.
tandem.p3: All pilots are equipped with specialized cameras. On request we capture photos during your flight, delivered on a 2 GB SD card for 10 €. If conditions allow, we can also provide a short HD video. Please bring your own water, sun block, and a warm jacket.
tandem.chooseLead: Two world-class flying sites — pick the one that fits your trip.
tandem.ohridText: Launch from Galicica National Park and fly above Ohrid and Prespa lakes. Ideal if you are staying on the Ohrid coast.
tandem.krusevoText: Launch from Meckin Kamen — one of the most visited take-offs in the region, with views over forests and the Pelagonia valley.
tandem.footnote: Passengers are required to sign an indemnity form; flying is undertaken entirely at their own risk.

tandemOhrid.heroSubtitle: Fly above Galicica: Ohrid Lake on one side, Prespa on the other.
tandemOhrid.intro: If you are staying in Ohrid, a tandem from the mountain near the lake is an unforgettable perspective on the national park. Certified pilots, transport from your hotel (or agreed meeting point), and photos & videos included in the packages below. National park entrance (about 5 €) applies.
tandemOhrid.earlyNote: Take-off Velestovo 1300 ASL (about 5–15 minutes), Paragliding flight above Ohrid
tandemOhrid.expNote: Take-off Galicica 1700 ASL about 10–30 minutes, high altitude difference. Pick-up in Ohrid or meet at Voena plaza.
tandemOhrid.xcNote: Take-off Galicica 1700 ASL or Jablanica 1600 ASL Longer flights when conditions allow — large altitude difference.

tandemKrusevo.heroSubtitle: Nature, forests, and valleys — different from city flying. Meckin Kamen is minutes from the town centre.
tandemKrusevo.p1: Have you ever dreamed of flying like a bird? In Krushevo you fly above forests and valleys instead of over urban sprawl. The area known as Meckin Kamen is one of the most visited take-off sites in the region.
tandemKrusevo.p2: From 79 € per person for a typical 10–15 minute flight. In good thermals, your pilot may offer a longer line and landing further down the valley — ground crew will pick you up. Extended option is typically +20 € (confirm on the day).
tandemKrusevo.p3: Wear hiking boots or supportive shoes and sunglasses; we provide the rest. You can bring a lunch pack or join the team for a meal if everyone agrees.
tandemKrusevo.alert: After you submit a reservation, please also reach us on WhatsApp / Viber so we can confirm weather and time.

faq.sectionLead: Quick answers about tandem flights and XC guiding in Macedonia.

items.q: Where can I fly tandem in Macedonia?
items.a: We offer tandem paragliding from Galicica above Ohrid Lake and from Meckin Kamen near Krushevo — two of the country’s best-known flying sites with lake, mountain, and valley views.

items.q: Do I need experience for a tandem flight?
items.a: No. You fly with a certified tandem pilot who controls the wing. You receive a short briefing before take-off.
We fly only in suitable weather, use inspected equipment, and work with experienced instructors. Tandem passengers should follow the pilot’s instructions and declare relevant health conditions.

items.q: What is XC guiding in Krushevo?
items.a: XC guiding is coaching for licensed pilots who want longer cross-country flights. Krushevo offers reliable conditions, briefings, retrieve, and debriefs — ideal for improving technique.

items.q: How do I book or check accommodation dates?
items.a: Use the calendar to select check-in and check-out, send a request, and the operator will confirm by email. Confirmed stays appear as booked on the calendar.
Most guests use Skopje International Airport (SKP). Transfers from Ohrid or Thessaloniki can often be arranged — mention your plans in the contact form.

seoLanding.title: Paragliding in Macedonia
seoLanding.lead: Macedonia is one of Europe’s most reliable flying destinations for tandem experiences and cross-country progression.
seoLanding.p1: North Macedonia combines mountain and flatland terrain, strong but manageable thermals, and a long flying season. This gives both first-time tandem passengers and licensed pilots excellent flight days.
seoLanding.p2: PG Macedonia operates with certified tandem pilots and experienced XC guides, focusing on safety, weather-based planning, and clear communication from booking to landing.
seoLanding.location1: Ohrid / Galicica — tandem flights over Ohrid and Prespa lakes.
seoLanding.location2: Krushevo / Meckin Kamen — tandem flights above forests and valleys.
seoLanding.location3: Krushevo XC area — guided cross-country coaching for licensed pilots.

seoOhrid.title: Paragliding in Ohrid
seoOhrid.lead: Fly above Ohrid Lake and Galicica with certified tandem pilots and weather-safe operations.
seoOhrid.whyTitle: Why Ohrid is special for paragliding
seoOhrid.p1: Ohrid combines mountain launch terrain and lake views that are unique in the Balkans. Flights from Galicica can reveal both Ohrid and Prespa lakes in one panorama.
seoOhrid.p2: For first-time passengers, tandem paragliding in Ohrid is one of the easiest ways to experience flight safely. For returning guests, weather windows offer different styles, from gentle morning flights to longer lines when conditions allow.
seoOhrid.expect1: Short safety briefing and harness setup before take-off.
seoOhrid.expect2: Weather-dependent timing for safer and smoother airtime.
seoOhrid.expect3: Optional photos and video during flight.
seoOhrid.tipText: Keep at least one flexible day in Ohrid so your flight can be scheduled in the best weather window.

faq.q: Do I need prior experience for paragliding in Ohrid?
faq.a: No. Tandem flights in Ohrid are designed for beginners; your pilot controls take-off, flight, and landing.

faq.q: How long is a tandem paragliding experience in Ohrid?
faq.a: The complete experience usually takes around 1.5 to 2 hours including transfer and briefing, while airtime depends on weather.

faq.q: When is the best period for paragliding in Ohrid?
faq.a: Most flights run from spring to autumn, with schedule and duration adjusted to daily weather conditions.

seoKrushevo.title: Paragliding in Krushevo
seoKrushevo.lead: Krushevo is one of Europe’s best known paragliding locations for both tandem flights and XC progression.
seoKrushevo.whyTitle: Why Krushevo ranks among top flying sites
seoKrushevo.p1: Meckin Kamen and the surrounding terrain provide reliable thermals, broad landing options, and routes suitable for different experience levels. This is why Krushevo repeatedly hosts high-level competitions.
seoKrushevo.p2: Visitors can choose a tandem flight for a first sky experience, while licensed pilots can use Krushevo for guided XC improvement with briefings, retrieve, and post-flight feedback.
seoKrushevo.expect1: Clear site briefing and weather-based launch planning.
seoKrushevo.expect2: Flights above forests, valleys, and the Pelagonia region.
seoKrushevo.expect3: Support options for both tandem guests and XC pilots.
seoKrushevo.tipText: If you stay several days in Krushevo, conditions often allow combining a tandem day with a guided XC day.

faq.q: Is Krushevo suitable for first-time tandem paragliding?
faq.a: Yes. Krushevo offers reliable conditions and established take-off areas, making it one of the most popular tandem locations in the region.

faq.q: Can licensed pilots book XC guiding in Krushevo?
faq.a: Yes. Krushevo is a core destination for guided XC progression with weather briefings, retrieve support, and coaching.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Krushevo paragliding?
faq.a: A multi-day stay is recommended so flights can be matched to the best weather windows and your goals.

seoSeason.title: Paragliding season in Macedonia
seoSeason.lead: The best time for paragliding in Macedonia depends on your location, weather goals, and whether you want tandem or XC flying.
seoSeason.p1: In general, spring through autumn is the main flying period in Macedonia. Krushevo and Ohrid both offer strong flying opportunities, but daily conditions vary and should always guide launch decisions.
seoSeason.p2: For tandem guests, flexibility is key: weather-based scheduling gives safer and better flights. For licensed XC pilots, longer stays improve the chance of catching stronger windows and completing bigger tasks.
seoSeason.month1: April–May: early-season consistency, often smoother mornings.
seoSeason.month2: June–August: stronger thermals, peak flying activity in Krushevo.
seoSeason.month3: September–October: stable autumn windows and good visibility.
seoSeason.month4: Day-to-day decisions always follow local weather and safety checks.
seoSeason.tipText: If possible, plan a 2–4 day window instead of one fixed slot to maximize your chance of ideal conditions.
